note: Numeric intents (CRYPTO_PRICE, CURRENCY_EXCHANGE, STOCK_PRICE, TVL_LOOKUP). The answer is a figure, so what separates right from wrong is the number, its unit, its magnitude and its direction. Cases are written for those failure modes: a right figure in a different format, a wrong figure in the right format, a right figure with the magnitude slipped by a factor of a thousand, and an entity swap that leaves the numbers intact.
